name: Sap's Fine Thai Cuisine
note: Long-running South Austin Thai spot with a big menu; owner also runs Super Thai
flags: Picked the West Gate Blvd location (original); a second location is at 5800 Burnet Rd. Hours conflict across sources (Daily 11am-10pm vs 11am-3am), so left null. Open status not confirmed from a 2025-2026 source. Website/Instagram/price not confirmed.

name: Dee Dee
note: Northern Thai/Isaan street-food trailer; get the khao soi and sai oua sausage
flags: Address/hours from an Austinot article (date not confirmed as 2025-2026). Owners are building a brick-and-mortar at 6405 Brodie Ln in Sunset Valley (ground-up, no opening date found); check whether the trailer has moved. Neighborhood guessed from the Menchaca Rd address.

name: Kiin Di
note: Fiery Thai street food; order Creamy Curry Crab, Killer Noodles, Thai Me Down roti
flags: Spelling is 'Kiin Di'. Was a food truck outside Corner Bar for four years; it moved into a brick-and-mortar at 2414 S Lamar (old Mr. Natural space), soft opening December 8 (2025 per search summary). One source lists the old truck info (1901 S Lamar, Wed-Sun 6pm-10pm), which is likely outdated, so hours left null. Instagram reported as @kiindi but not confirmed.

name: Super Thai Cuisine
note: Huge menu of Thai classics and regional dishes; takeout up front, bar and dining room
flags: Owned by Sap Apisaksiri (Sap's Fine Thai); opened at the former Krua Urban Thai space. A Toast ordering page named 'Siam's ATX Thai Cuisine' also uses 2024 South Lamar, so it may have been renamed; could not confirm. Hours came from a delivery listing (Uber Eats/FoodBoss), not the official site.

name: PhởNatic
address: 2525 W Anderson Ln, Suite 280, Austin, TX 78757
note: Fast-casual Vietnamese: pho, vermicelli bowls, banh mi and sliders
flags: Picked the Northcross (W Anderson Ln) location. Chain began in 2011 and has had other locations (Southwest Austin, Cedar Park), but the current count wasn't confirmed, so locations is null. Sources didn't mention Vietnamese tacos. Hours not confirmed. Open status based on a current job posting and Toast page, not a 2025-2026 article.
